notes.title: A small content update and some bug hunting!
notes.content:
Hello!
Just making a few bug fixes and some extra content, I've done a previews patch update but I'll say all I've change in this and in the previews patch, also, I want to hear from you!

Bug Fixes
-Fixed a bug where Tutorial could be skipped on occasions on a new save if it had already been finished in another save.
-Fixed Earth Titan Boss not dropping loot (to you, the one how defeated the Earth Titan and didn't unlocked a new powerful spell, I'm sorry, you've been robbed, I hope you beat him again, this time he will behave).

New Stuff!
-New upgrade! Life Refraction, useful for those of you that are using a lot of spells.
-New secret achievement! I can't say no more...
-New Spell! Hold Position, an strategic spell for drone heavy builds.

That's all for now, I would love to hear from you Are you having fun!? Are you being beaten to a pulp? Let me know. Also, please don't forget to leave a review! They are extremely important for the game's visibility, very few people even know it exists! 

Thanks for reading and have a nice weekend!
Jos

notes.title: First Patch! (and a little more) - 10/1/2025

Just a small patch that fixes some bugs, and a little extra content, just to say thanks to all of you for buying and playing the game!

-A new upgrade! Life Refractor, a nice tool to have if you are using a lot of spells...
-New secret achievement... it's secret so.. but it's there!

Thanks for reading, I must sleep now.
Take care!

notes.title: Demo hot-fix update
notes.content:
Hello fellow Commanders!

I'm making a small update to the demo, these are the main changes:
[list]
[*]Hot-fix regarding the "Auto-climb" ladder feature, where very thin platforms caused some odd behaviour. Should work better now.
[*]Re-balancing to the "Mobility" permanent upgrade (slight de-buff).
[*]A new upgrade! CDrone, a drone equipped with Fire Damage bullets, to round out a potential "Fire" and/or "Drones" build.
[/list]

I'm starting to work on an alpha/beta test, stay tuned for that and some other exciting news coming soon and thanks for your interest!

notes.title: 🎉 Celebrating Roguelike Celebration And Demo Update!
notes.content:
I'm proud to say that Commander Tiberius Troubleson is taking part in this very exclusive roguelike event for the second time in a row!
There are many other awesome games you should check out—many of them are on sale right now!

[h2]Demo Update[/h2]
I've also pushed a minor demo update with some improvements and fixes. The main ones are:
[list]
[*]A brand new spell: Ember Field. It creates a field of embers that follows the caster, burning nearby enemy units.
[*]Improved UI when editing your Arsenal (equipped spells and upgrades).
[*]Clearer indications when you're about to disable the last Mana Pump on each level.
[*]Auto-Finish Climbing Ropes: When you're very close to the top of a rope, you'll automatically climb all the way up, avoiding a tricky situation where it looks like you've cleared the rope but are still technically in "climb" mode.
[*]Various bug fixes and minor balance tweaks, specifically for the demo.
[/list]
That's all for now! I hope you give it a try, and don't forget to share your feedback and impressions.
Also, if you want to stay fully updated or share anything else with me, come say hi on the Discord server:

notes.title: New Demo Version and Update about release date.
notes.content:
Hello fellow Commanders!
I bring news and gifts.
I've just updated the demo to a new version, full of new upgrades and spells to find. Poison upgrades, freezing upgrades, fire upgrades, drones, a shield, and many others. Try the new spells as well and let me know what you think!

I had to push the release date a little bit further away due to some unforeseen events, but the game is progressing well, I will announce the release date soon, I'm still defining the exact day, I can say it's going to be early during Q1 2025 -and just between you and me, it's probably going to be on January, but don't tell anyone! :)

I'll also be releasing a new trailer soon, showing all the new stuff -spells, bosses, mini bosses and one or two secrets- And I'll update the steam page to reflect those.

notes.title: Demo Update 3!
notes.content:
I've just updated the demo; this might be the final update until release. Here are the key features, changes, and fixes you can expect:

[h2]New Features:[/h2]

    Mini Bosses: Now, apart from the sporadic appearance of boss levels, each level has a mini boss waiting for you to spawn on the last Mana Pump; plan accordingly!

    Level Up: When you finish each level, you'll use Mana Gems to level up different stats. The Mana Gems are formed by collecting Mana during the level and filling the Mana bar. In the beginning, you'll only be able to fill up to two Mana Gems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43797815/aad13715f7116bb40812ff74c528c0a56083f114.gif[/img]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]

    Mana Cost: Spells no longer cost Mana to cast; the only limit is the amount of uses it has, so you can now spam a spell to your heart's content! There might be a few exceptions in the future, but none for the demo.

    Enhanced Movement Mechanics: All actions are queued so that gameplay feels even more fluid.

[h2]Bug Fixes and Optimization:[/h2]

    Numerous bug fixes: I've kept addressing several issues reported by you. These fixes include resolving gameplay issues, graphical bugs, and other minor problems that may have affected your enjoyment of the game.

Please note that previous saved files and settings are not compatible with this new version. This is unfortunate but necessary; please forgive the inconvenience.

Thanks for all the support and feedback! I hope you enjoy the new features! Feel free to share your thoughts and suggestions with me on [url=https://discord.gg/sGJG6merxn]Discord[/url] to help make Commander Tiberius Troubleson better!

Have fun exploring the world of Anarth!

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
I've just updated the demo, which I have been working on diligently. Here are the key improvements, changes, and fixes you can expect:

[h2]Gameplay Changes and Improvements:[/h2]

    Upgrades Dispenser: I've added a new object called the Upgrades Dispenser, which will be present in every level. It allows you to choose between two upgrades and grants you the one you select. This feature adds a new strategic element to your run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43797815/987ef6cb537e901629226106eca78a95ce23d7e8.png[/img]

    Spell Seller: The Spell Seller has undergone a revamp. Now, the Spell Seller exclusively sells spells, and you can purchase up to three of them. This change provides more flexibility, allowing you to experiment with various magical abilities.

    Improved Ladders and Ropes: I've made significant adjustments to the interaction with ladders and ropes. They should now feel much smoother and easier to deal with, grabbing them mid air and going up or down.

    Enhanced Movement Mechanics: I've made general improvements to the movement mechanics, resulting in a more fluid and responsive control system.

[h2]New Content Additions:[/h2]

    New Upgrades: I've introduced a wide range of new upgrades for you to discover and utilize in your journey. These upgrades will offer fresh gameplay mechanics and enhance your abilities, allowing for more diverse strategies and approaches.

    Additional Spells: Alongside the new upgrades, I've included a few new spells for you to master. Experiment with different combinations and find the ones that best suit your playstyle.

    Balancing and Difficulty Adjustments: I've made various tweaks and changes to the game's difficulty to ensure a more balanced and engaging experience. Your progression through the game should feel more satisfying and challenging, while still being fair and enjoyable.

[h2]Bug Fixes and Optimization:[/h2]

    Numerous bug fixes: I've addressed several issues reported by you, our dedicated player. These fixes include resolving gameplay glitches, graphical anomalies, and other minor problems that may have affected your enjoyment of the game.

    New Input System: I've upgraded the input system to allow a more gamepads to work correctly. Even though the only officially supported gamepad is still the USB XBox 360 one, I've tested with a few others and they all seem to work well. I have not tested the PS4 controller, and the wireless one might not work properly, so you might need to use an USB wire for it.


Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback! I hope you enjoy the new features, improvements, and fixes in this update. As always, feel free to share your thoughts and suggestions with me to help make Commander Tiberius Troubleson an even better gaming experience. Have fun exploring the world of Anarth!

notes.title: Demo coming soon and Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
[h2]Steam Next Fest[/h2]
First, I wanted to let you know I'll be streaming at some point in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, I'll post more info about the schedule, but count on me being there.

[h2]CTT Demo Coming Soon[/h2]
This is the big one, I've been working hard on having a demo up as soon as possible, I need to have one for the Steam Next Fest, but I'm hoping to upload it before the end of May so you can give it a try!

[h2]Spell Pocket and More Upgrades Slots [/h2]
I've added a "spell pocket". This will allow to have a third spell equipped and switch it on the fly, mid-combat. Currently is mapped by default to the TAB key or the right stick click on controllers, but I want to do some more testing.
I've also made a design decision and added two more upgrade slots, this will allow more powerful synergies and this goes inline with my core philosophy about the game: fun first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43797815/0c3624dcb6b89847a2a31bba18efd3d71bfcb24f.gif[/img]

[h3]Other news[/h3]
I have been doing many level variants and I'm hoping to make a few more before the demo. I also have plans for many upgrades and some new spells.
